The Court Made The Following:
 Order

The captioned petition is filed by accused Nos.1 to 3, seeking quashing of proceedings pending in C.C.No.424/2023 arising out of crime No.154/2022 for the offence punishable under Sections 376,
323, 504, 506, 114 read with Section 34 of Indian Penal Code, 1860.
2.

Today, a joint compromise petition is filed under Section 482 read with Section 320(2) of Cr.P.C.
NC: 2023:KHC:25251 Accused No.1 and respondent No.2/complainant are present before this Court.
This Court has enquired with respondent No.2/complainant.
Respondent No.2/complainant has made a statement before this Court that she has married accused No.1/petitioner No.1 and they are leading a happy married life.
Respondent No.2/complainant also makes a statement that, after the marriage, she has joined the marital home of her husband and both are residing together.

By way of a joint compromise petition, accused No.1 and respondent No.2/complainant have sought quashing of the proceedings, indicating that accused No.1/petitioner No.1 marriage was solemnized with respondent No.2/complainant on 02.02.2023.
To evidence the marriage, a copy of the marriage certificate was also placed on record.
On examining the material on record, this Court would find that a crime came to be registered against accused No.1/petitioner No.1 and his family Koushik K vs State

By on 20 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/131209596/
2 members, alleging that petitioner No.1, having assured that he will marry respondent No.2,
retracted from the NC: 2023:KHC:25251 said promise and this led to the initiation of criminal proceedings.
Consequently, the investigation officer has laid a charge sheet for the above said offences.

3. If the parties have resolved the dispute and petitioner No.1/accused No.1 has eventually married respondent No.2/complainant, I am of the view that to meet the ends of justice, the proceedings in C.C.No.424/2023 are liable to be quashed.

In the interest of justice, I am inclined to accede to the joint request made by respondent No.2/complainant and petitioners for quashing of the charge sheet filed in C.C.No.424/2023.
4.
In the light of joint compromise petition, the proceedings pending in C.C.No.424/2023 are hereby quashed.
The pending interlocutory applications, if any, does not survive for consideration and stands disposed of.

Sd/-
